shipping_retained_damage_path.geometric_reason: for a nondegenerate tetrahedron, the centroid is strictly interior. A plane through that centroid cannot be the supporting plane of a boundary face; distinct tet interiors share at most a lower-dimensional boundary. Thus the generic guard’s exact full-face duplicate case is excluded by this authored zero-offset construction, subject to the implementation tolerance and the normal mesh-quality checks.
